baseFrontend: validated Admin 7 runtime with native NexoWatt stable auto updates, fixed Intro scrollbar, clean login and verified user passwords
label: v7100
notes: Installed NexoWatt adapters use native stable auto updates by default and can be disabled.
The Cockpit/Intro surface has a permanent visible vertical scrollbar while header and navigation remain fixed.
The product login uses one compact MUI Paper card with permanently notched labels and no overlap.
First-login and reset passwords use canonical ioBroker user IDs first with a legacy short-name fallback.
Passwords are accepted only after the user-object hash changes and the new credential is verified.
Release assets are tagged 7100 and delivered with no-store handling through the existing release watcher.
changes: Restored the scroll surface in CSS and the productive stable runtime.
Removed the fixed login minimum height and corrected MUI label/notch geometry.
Corrected login Paper ownership to prevent nested form sizing.
Strengthened password writes with four controller API variants and explicit backend error codes.
Kept the NexoWatt stable auto-update manager and its default-enabled toggle unchanged.
